resisted: No structural problems (no splits needed). Thailand-by-hours interaction inert in practice. Rare categories act as huge switches fitted to very few rows (Preschool +43 logit/64 rows, Never-worked +20/9, Columbia +8/64, Honduras -4/14): probably overfitting. Category names inferred.
tool_bugs: None (agent-side zsh wrapper issue; stray np.save files moved out of repo). SHAP ~9e-4 on unconnected inputs (noise).
summary: P(income<=50K) = sigmoid(1.382 + 10 independent additive logit terms). Largest: sparse linear backbone over 47 inputs (removing it: AUC 0.907 -> 0.714). Two real nonlinearities: concave piecewise-linear capital-gain penalty (kinks ~4.4k and 4.7k USD; ablation AUC 0.890) and convex hours term (kinks ~19 h and 50 h). Remaining hidden units are single-category offsets or saturating switches. Train acc 0.851, AUC 0.907.
